# Layout test fonts

Test-only copies of the exact font bytes requested by google_fonts 6.3.3:

- Quicksand Bold: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/a/1a693fb78c1624ba780e833d6e40a6f2cd6355b39e30011e63bcd00c70fda8e8.ttf
- Jua Regular: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/a/a083a3d69c7ef047913364d28dcd22c0f134b9e92800d60c31d065a6f8659b97.ttf

Used by the layout test's mock HTTP client so screen tests do not need network access.
These files are not included in the app assets. Both fonts are under the SIL Open Font License.
